name: Thunder Client
summary: Thunder Client is an API client inside VS Code and JetBrains. Free allows 10 collections and 50 local runner runs a month per user. Starter costs $3, Business $7 and Enterprise $16 per user a month, billed annually.

facts.text: Running collections on a build server requires the Git Sync feature.
The pricing page lists Git Sync on the Starter, Business and Enterprise plans and not on Free.
The tc command runs a collection and writes XML, HTML, JSON or CSV reports, and the docs include a sample GitHub Actions workflow.
The collection runner supports sequential and parallel runs, CSV or JSON data files, iterations and a delay between requests.
Global and Local environments and .env files require the paid version.
The pricing page says local runner limits are monthly and that CI/CD runs have no limit.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 10 collections, 50 requests per collection, 50 local runner runs a month, no credit card required

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Billed annually; the page shows no monthly-billing price. Individual license, credit card only. Adds Git Sync, unlimited collections and 250 runner runs a month

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Billed annually; the page shows no monthly-billing price. Adds team and user management, centralized billing and 500 runner runs a month

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Billed annually; the page shows no monthly-billing price. Unlimited runner runs, offline activation, audit logs and secrets manager integration

hiddenCosts: The pricing page footnote says Enterprise single sign-on carries an additional cost, but it does not state the amount.
